item.title: Microsoft outage disrupts Met Police, Parliament and London schools
item.body: An outage affecting Outlook email, Teams and other Microsoft apps has disrupted the Met Police, Parliament and London schools. A number of councils and NHS trusts are also affected.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🔴 Microsoft outage disrupts Met Police, Parliament and London schools

An outage affecting Outlook email, Teams and other Microsoft apps has disrupted the Met Police, Parliament and London schools. A number of councils and NHS trusts are also affected.

Source: Evening Standard
UK Daily Briefing | 13 November, 09:50

#BreakingNews #MicrosoftOutage #London
